Green, pale blue, red and grey fills; condition text on the arrows. The caption line prints above the diagram at the top of p9.

rules: Four of the eleven printed figures are printed tables (3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4), so they are recorded in the table block as table-grid and this paper contributes no table-as-figure rows [table.rows].

Figure 2.3's caption is the last text on p8 while its strip is at the bottom of p8, and Figure 2.2's caption opens p8 above the strip of p7: captions are quoted from the page that carries them [caption.verbatim].
Figure 2.4's caption prints above the flowchart at the top of p9, the only exhibit in this paper whose caption sits above it [caption.position].
Figure 4.2 and Figure 4.4 each carry a two-row header with spanned and stub cells, so header_rows is 2 and merged_cells is true [table.header_rows] [table.merged_cells].
The three rule styles in the paper are boxed grids (3.1, 4.1, 4.2), vertical rules with a stub column (3.1, 4.4) and no zebra shading anywhere [table.rule_style] [table.zebra].
Only Figures 4.2, 4.3 and 4.4 are cited in running text; the strip figures are read only through their captions [mention.lead_sentence].
